Name: m1_welcome_0
Dialogue: Marcy::You're the new one. Rowan, right? The hostel clerk says you walked in off the Greyhound with one bag and a map you didn't need.|Rowan::The map's for appearances. I'm good with roads.|Marcy::Good. In Calgary the road is the whole religion. Chinook arch overhead, Prairie Trail underneath, and everyone late for something.|Marcy::First-day job, nothing spicy. Walk over to the curb marker, there's a loaner Kestrel waiting for you.

Name: m1_welcome_1
Text: Walk to the marker. WASD to move, hold Shift to sprint, Space to jump.

Name: m1_welcome_2
Text: Get into the loaner Kestrel. Press E next to the car.

Name: m1_welcome_3
Text: Pick up the order at Prairie Rye Bakery. Stop inside the marker.

Name: m1_welcome_4
Dialogue: Baker::Marcy's friend? Two dozen rye loaves and the cinnamon buns. Hot, so don't take the long way.|Rowan::Where's it going?|Baker::Foothills Grand Hotel. Their valet bay. Press M and drop a waypoint if you've forgotten the way.

Name: m1_welcome_5
Text: Press M to open the city map. Left-click anywhere to set a waypoint, right-click to clear it.

Name: m1_welcome_6
Text: Deliver the bread to the Foothills Grand Hotel valet bay.

Name: m1_welcome_7
Dialogue: Valet::Right on time, and still warm. You must be Marcy's find.|Marcy::(radio) Told you. Keep the Kestrel for now, Rowan. Come see me at the diner when you're ready for more.

Name: m2_delivery_0
Dialogue: Marcy::Calder Tower has a contract that can't be late. The law office across downtown closes its loading dock 150 seconds after you collect it.|Rowan::Downtown at rush hour?|Marcy::Welcome to the job. Lights are your friend and parked delivery vans are not. Park inside the marker, and fully stop.

Name: m2_delivery_1
Text: Pick up the sealed contract at Calder Tower. Stop inside the marker.

Name: m2_delivery_2
Text: Deliver the contract to Riverfront Law Offices before the dock closes.

Name: m2_delivery_3
Dialogue: Clerk::Signed, sealed, and with eleven seconds to spare in my head. Thank you.|Marcy::(radio) That's a clean run. People notice clean runs.

Name: m3_missing_0
Dialogue: Owen::Thanks for coming out. My father started this company with one truck and a handshake. Tuesday night a Ranchhand pickup vanished from our lot.|Owen::The police have a form for it. I have forty deliveries a week and one fewer truck.|Rowan::You think it's in an industrial yard.|Owen::Three yards take things in without asking much. Check Yard A, B and C. If you find it, drive it out.

Name: m3_missing_1
Text: Search the vehicle yards for Whitaker's missing Ranchhand pickup.

Name: m3_missing_2
Dialogue: Hector::You found it. My cousin parked it here for safekeeping. Look, I can pretend I never saw you, or we can discuss a finder's fee.|Rowan::(thinking) Whitaker would pay for honesty. Dunbar Wreckers pays for silence. Hector wants a cut either way.

Name: m3_missing_3
Text: What do you do with the truck?
ChoiceA: Drive it back to Owen Whitaker|
ChoiceB: Sell it to Dunbar Wreckers, no questions asked|
ChoiceC: Pay Hector $250 to forget the whole thing|cash>=250

Name: m3_missing_4
Text: Return the pickup to Whitaker Freight Co.

Name: m3_missing_5
Dialogue: Owen::That's my truck. I won't ask how, because you look like someone who'll tell me the honest version later.|Owen::Take this. And Rowan, my door is open.

Name: m3_missing_7
Text: Deliver the pickup to Dunbar Auto Wreckers.

Name: m3_missing_8
Dialogue: Wrecker::Nice truck. It will be forty parts by Friday. No paperwork, no names. That's the whole deal.|Wrecker::Fourteen hundred. Cash. Smile, you're on nobody's camera.

Name: m4_highway_0
Dialogue: Marcy::Dante's drivers run Prairie Trail like it's their driveway. I need to know you can keep up. Not impress them. Keep up.|Marcy::There's a Stampede RS out front. Borrowed, so bring it back in one piece. Six checkpoints down the highway, 200 seconds.|Rowan::Traffic?|Marcy::Lots. That's the point.

Name: m4_highway_1
Text: Get into the Stampede RS.

Name: m4_highway_2
Text: Drive to the Prairie Trail on-ramp.

Name: m4_highway_3
Text: Hit all six highway checkpoints. Merge cleanly and watch the traffic.

Name: m4_highway_4
Dialogue: ('Marcy::(radio) Not bad. Smooth through the Southbridge overpass. Bring the car back to Bow Valley Auto Works, the garage guys will check it over.',)

Name: m4_highway_5
Text: Return the Stampede RS to Bow Valley Auto Works.

Name: m5_rival_0
Dialogue: Owen::Dante Kowalczyk wants the Foothills Brewery pallet contract. He's quoting under cost, which means he's not hauling beer, he's hauling something else.|Owen::Go see him at Redline Hauling. Talk if you can. I won't tell you how to handle him.

Name: m5_rival_1
Text: Meet Dante at Redline Hauling.

Name: m5_rival_2
Dialogue: Dante::Rowan. Marcy's driver, Whitaker's errand-runner. You'd be surprised how small this city is when it's thirty below.|Dante::The contract is a lane, and I'm already driving in it. You can pull over, or we can find out who the lane belongs to.|Dante::Pick your weather.

Name: m5_rival_3
Text: How do you answer Dante?
ChoiceB: Challenge him to a race for the contract|

Name: m5_rival_4
Dialogue: Dante::You carry Owen's name like a coat that fits. Fine. Half the lane, and we both stop pretending.|Dante::Tell Whitaker the pallets split down the middle. And Rowan. Come see me if you ever outgrow his hours.

Name: m5_rival_6
Text: Beat Dante's Stampede through all four checkpoints in the industrial district.

Name: m5_rival_7
Dialogue: ('Dante::(leaning on his hood) A clean line through Freight Road 14. All right, the contract is yours. This time.',)

Name: m5_rival_9
Text: Wreck Dante's convoy truck before it reaches its drop-off.

Name: m5_rival_10
Dialogue: ("Marcy::(radio) That was loud. Dante's people are already talking about you. Keep your head down for a day or two.",)

Name: m6_afterdark_0
Dialogue: Marcy::It's dark enough now. Here's the shape of it: a sealed package at the Airport Cargo Depot. Dante wants it, the police want to know who has it, and I want you alive.|Rowan::That's a long list of wants.|Marcy::That's every job in this city after dark. Go. Don't stop until you hear from me.

Name: m6_afterdark_1
Text: Collect the package at the Airport Cargo Depot.

Name: m6_afterdark_2
Dialogue: Handler::It's yours. Three cars just rolled into the lot, Redline plates, and I don't think they're here for coffee.|Handler::Back gate. Go.

Name: m6_afterdark_3
Text: Lose Dante's crew and reach Warehouse 9.

Name: m6_afterdark_4
Dialogue: ("Marcy::(radio) Scanner says FRPS got a tip. Inspector Calloway's units are converging on you. You're about to be very popular.",)

Name: m6_afterdark_5
Text: Lose the police. Break line of sight and stay hidden until the search ends.

Name: m6_afterdark_6
Text: The Inspector wants to meet at the Bow River. Walk or drive to the meeting point.

Name: m6_afterdark_7
Dialogue: Calloway::Rowan Vale. I'm Inspector Calloway. I've watched you for three weeks. You've been careful, which means you've been paid to be.|Dante::(stepping out of the dark) Inspector. You always did choose the better view. Rowan, that package is a lane. Hand it over and the lane's yours.|Marcy::(radio, quiet) Whatever you pick, pick it fast.

Name: m6_afterdark_8
Text: Who gets the package?
ChoiceC: Throw it into the Bow River|

Name: m6_afterdark_9
Dialogue: ("Calloway::That's not a favour, it's a start. People who help me eventually get to leave the game.|Calloway::Go home, Rowan. Sleep.",)

Name: m6_afterdark_11
Dialogue: ('Dante::Smart. The city is a river, Rowan. You can be the current or you can be the bridge.|Dante::Eight thousand. And my number.',)

Name: m6_afterdark_13
Dialogue: ("Marcy::(radio) You... threw it in the Bow? Rowan. That's the most Calgary thing I've ever heard.|Marcy::Nobody gets it. Nobody wins. Come by the diner. First round's on me.",)
